# Imran Khan — Full-Stack Engineer & AI Backend Developer

> Imran Khan is a full-stack engineer and AI backend developer based in Mumbai. He builds dependable software for messy workflows: healthcare APIs, fleet operations, billing and payout systems, realtime collaboration, and AI infrastructure.

## Current role

- AI Backend Developer, Boston Institute of Analytics India
- Contributing backend engineering to MedConnect across article publishing, job discovery and applications, resume workflows, feeds, and media delivery
- Built article APIs for slug-based detail, owner draft access, published-status filtering, and complete create responses
- Improved jobs and applications with fresher flags, multi-city/state data, search, recommendations, recent applications, visibility rules, and pagination
- Strengthened resume, profile, feed, and media workflows with status checks, readable filenames, user-specific response fields, normalized paths, and reusable URL handling

## Strongest projects

### DriveAccessible

Production fleet-management and car-rental operations SaaS covering vehicle inventory, booking availability, billing, payment tracking, renewals, and operational workflows. Stack: Core PHP, JavaScript, MySQL. Period: October 2025 to March 2026.

### AgentLens

AI reliability runtime routing requests across 8 model providers with health-aware scoring, circuit breakers, retries, telemetry, rate limiting, explainable failover decisions, Python and TypeScript SDKs, Postgres-backed controls, and HMAC API-key storage. Local validation is clearly separated from external production usage. Stack: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker. Live: https://agentlens-web.vercel.app/

### TalkingResume / ResumeIQ

Evidence-led technical hiring workspace connecting resumes to GitHub repositories, commits, projects, and source files. Answers are grounded in exact evidence and citations rather than keyword matching. Company-specific work simulations are planned, not shipped. Live: https://talkingresume.netlify.app/

### Office Operations Hub

Schema-led company operations workspace for employee, finance, procurement, IT, legal, travel, workplace, and feedback workflows. Current implementation boundaries are explicit; not every integration is claimed production-ready.

### Interfaze Verify

Full-stack structured extraction review workspace with user-defined schemas, document submission, confidence-coded bounding boxes, field-to-region links, normalisation, declarative validation, provider and fixture adapters, audit events, JSON export, SQLite persistence, and review history. Synthetic fixtures and unverified live provider paths are labelled.

### BillingOS

Multi-tenant billing engine modelled on Stripe Billing with subscription lifecycle, proration invoices, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, Bull/Redis exponential-backoff retries, idempotent Stripe webhook processing, configurable rate limiting, and PDF invoices. Stack: Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, PDFKit.

### Payout Engine

Merchant payout engine using integer paise arithmetic, immutable ledger operations, SELECT FOR UPDATE locking, idempotency keys, atomic failure/refund handling, and stuck-payout recovery. Stack: Django, PostgreSQL, Celery, Redis. Live: https://payout-engine-ten.vercel.app/

### AI Model Governance Platform

Review workspace with a model registry, server-enforced workflow state machine, role-based transitions, append-only audit trail, document-grounded Q&A, pgvector retrieval, local embeddings, five-provider LLM fallback, schema validation, confidence scores, and source citations. Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, React.
